repackFeatures: Based on Steam release BuildID 9735547: 47.1 GB, thanks to Cabriodriver for files!

Steam-2-GOG and GOG-to-Steam conversion is available at any moment after installation, so you can install Steam and GOG patches in the future. Use corresponding .BAT files in the game root for conversion
CODEX crack/emu applied over; Alternative ALI213 crack is located in NoDVD folder after installation; Thanks to machine4578 & Cringebowler!
Protector Pack DLC is included and activated
100% Lossless & MD5 Perfect: all files are identical to originals after installation (ONLY when installed with all voicepacks!)
Selective Download feature: you may skip downloading and installing of voicepacks you don’t need
Significantly smaller archive size (compressed from 47.1 to 24.2~26.7 GB, depending on selected components)
Installation takes from 15 minutes (on 24-threads CPU) up to 45 minutes (on 4-threads CPU)
After-install integrity check so you could make sure that everything installed properly
Language can be changed in game settings
To make Japanese language selectable in game settings, copy “_GOGLangDef.tsc” file to “LangDef.tsc”
Repack uses XTool library by Razor12911
At least 3 GB of free RAM (inc. virtual) required for installing this repack
gameDescriptionHtml:
Far across the sea, an island calls…
Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world twisted by supernatural forces.

After escaping their devastated homeland, Amicia and Hugo travel far south, to new regions and vibrant cities. There, they attempt to start a new life and control Hugo’s curse.

But, when Hugo’s powers reawaken, death and destruction return in a flood of devouring rats. Forced to flee once more, the siblings place their hopes in a prophesized island that may hold the key to saving Hugo.

Discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell, overcoming foes and challenges with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.

Game Features

  • Sequel to the award-winning adventure A Plague Tale: Innocence
  • A spectacular grounded tale twisted by supernatural forces
  • Use a variety of tools, sneak, fight, or unleash hell and rats
  • Stunning visuals combine with an enthralling score
